en.title: About AiFi
en.heading:
Understand new tech and money,
one step at a time.
en.body: AiFi explains new technology and money in plain language: step-by-step tutorials you can follow, and deep dives into how financial systems actually work.
writer: I’m Frederic. I try it first, then explain it.
If something here helps you try a new tool or understand where money goes, it did its job.

zh-Hant.title: 關於 AiFi
zh-Hant.heading:
一步一步，
看懂新科技與金融。
zh-Hant.body: AiFi 用白話介紹新科技和金融：有一步一步帶你操作的教學，也有拆解金融系統怎麼運作的深度文章。
writer: 我是 Frederic。先親手試，再講清楚。
如果這裡的內容能幫你試用一個新工具，或看懂錢往哪裡流，就達到目的了。
